ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes and 35% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the central peduncle attachment and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity (black) wedge extending from the notch, transitioning via a mottled gradient into high-intensity (white) fields occupying the mid and outer sections of both lobes. A continuous low-intensity band follows the entire trailing edge contour.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 28 degrees relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels. Distinct macro-notch present on the distal end of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep of the lobes with a convex leading edge and a generally concave trailing edge trajectory toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of dark, circular pixel groupings on the mid-region of the left lobe within the high-intensity zone. Scattered white circular points visible in the central dark region near the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) detected on the ventral surface of the left lobe, cutting through the high-intensity white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular indentation and loss of smooth contour at the far-left distal tip, indicating localized physical trauma or persistent scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific 'spray' mottling pattern at the transition zone between the central black pigmentation and the white lateral lobes.
